summary: CI上のAgent workflowは、GITHUB_TOKENをcontents:read既定、pull_request_target/workflow_runでのfork checkoutを避け、untrusted入力はenv経由、environment protectionでsecret注入前に承認、first-time contributor gate、action SHA pin、Agentのtool allowlist最小化、Agent版を修正済み以上に固定する

evidence.summary: GITHUB_TOKEN read-only既定、pull_request_target/workflow_runでのfork checkout回避、untrusted inputはenv経由、環境保護でsecretに承認、full SHA pinのみ不変、OIDC推奨。AI agent固有記述なし
Comment-and-Control系: PR title/issue body/commentからのinjectionでsecret読出し。修正2.1.128（2026-05-05）。緩和: Rule of Two、key per workflow、tool allowlist、system prompt hardening、token監視・rotation
Claude Code Security Review/Gemini CLI Action/Copilot Agentが同一手法で乗っ取り可能と開示、hardened Actions設定（permissions、environment protection、first-time contributor gate）で遮断
-p headlessではtrust verification無効、network commandは既定非自動許可

agentic-actions-auditor (public, reputation established): read SKILL.md on skills.sh: it performs static security analysis of GitHub Actions workflows that invoke AI coding agents (Claude Code Action, Gemini CLI, Codex), checking trigger exposure, tool permissions, user allowlists, and the event-context-to-prompt data path — the same attack surface this remedy tells the developer to close.
